what: A square image sits at the hero center, flanked by two big text blocks. On open, the text gathers from ∓40% outside in 1.6s expo.out and the description lines rise from 20px below in .08s steps. With the panel pinned to the screen (for 60%), even a small scroll down expands the image to fill the screen (100vw×100vh) in 1.1s expo.inOut while the text exits to ∓60% outside, and scroll rolls itself to the pin end in 1.1s (one-step paging). Scrolling up folds it back to original size in .9s, the text returns, and the description reappears .3s later in .6s

options.push: Percent the text is pushed outward (xPercent), default 60
options.min: Unfolds only at this width (px) or above, default 901 — below that, entrance only
options.intro: if off, turns off the initial entrance
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Center image (size comes from the consumer’s css — the part centers it)
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Description lines that hide and appear together (several)

use:
STUDIO

One-line About

from.where: about.html · detail.html hero .ph — square photo between the name and the work title

note: When auto-scrolling, if window.lenis (or __lenis) exists it uses lenis.scrollTo (lock · force), otherwise the window’s smooth scroll. With reduced motion, nothing unfolds and it stays in its initial shape
